title: Prahlada and Narasimha, Part 2 of 2 | Bhagavata Purana
sources: Bhagavata Purana, Canto 7, chapter 8 (Narasimha emerges from the pillar), chapters 8-9 (his anger calmed by Prahlada).

lines.text: Part two. How do you kill a man who cannot be killed?
lines.caps: *Part two. | How do you kill | the *unkillable?

lines.text: The king mocked his son. Where is your Vishnu? Is he in this pillar?
Prahlada answered calmly. He is everywhere. Even in this pillar.
Furious, the king struck the pillar.
It was dusk. Not day. Not night.
The pillar split open. Out stepped Narasimha: half man, half lion. Not a man. Not a beast.
He lifted the king to the doorway. Not inside. Not outside.
He laid him across his lap. Not on the ground. Not in the sky.
lines.caps: Not on the *ground. | Not in the *sky.

lines.text: And with his bare claws, no weapon at all, the tyrant's reign was over.
The lion's fury shook the worlds. Even the gods stood back. Only Prahlada stepped forward, and prayed.
The boy's devotion calmed the lion. The boon was clever. But devotion was stronger.
